text:
claire: getting a handful of apiserver auth latency alerts in ap-southeast1, started ~12:34 UTC. controller-manager is requeuing a bunch of node-controller work and GPU provisioning is delayed :frowning:
sam: seeing it on our dashboards too, p95 auth latency up to 1.6s, p50 ~300ms. pods with GPU taints failing to schedule because node objects aren't observed.
priya: can someone grab apiserver logs and etcd leader metrics? wondering if auth webhook or etcd is the bottleneck.
jacob: quick run: `kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system kube-apiserver -o wide` looks normal, endpoints present. ran `kubectl get endpointslices -n kube-system` also OK.
sam: posting small log snippet from apiserver around the spike:

```
I0310 12:34:15.123456 1 wrap.go:42] GET /api/v1/nodes?fieldSelector=spec.taints: (920.321ms) 200
W0310 12:34:16.234567 1 authentication.go:183] TokenReview latency: 1.4s
E0310 12:34:16.234678 1 traces.go:52] oauth webhook timeout after 1s
```

priya: that TokenReview line points at our OIDC introspection? infra-bot, did we have any identity provider incidents?
infra-bot: identity-provider: ok, no region-wide errors logged. Auth-proxy pod restarted once at 12:30 due to OOMKilled on node g4-12-03, restarted and healthy.
claire: controller-manager logs show repeated failures creating cloudprovider calls for GPU nodes. snippet:

```
E0310 12:35:01 controller.go:215] Failed syncing node gpu-asia-23: unable to update node status: apiserver timeout
I0310 12:35:02 controller.go:98] Requeuing node gpu-asia-23 for backoff
```

jacob: could be transient auth webhook latency causing apiserver auth chain to block, which then blocks node status updates. Suggest increasing webhook timeout to 2s as mitigation and add fallback allow on failure for node status updates.
sam: +1 for temporary webhook timeout bump. Also we should check etcd commit latency: `etcdctl --endpoints=https://etcd-0:2379 endpoint status --write-out=table` shows leader write RTT 320ms earlier but now 1.2s.
priya: ordering: (1) bump webhook timeout and rollout to ap-southeast1 control plane pods, (2) add temporary retry/backoff in node-controller config, (3) monitor.
claire: I'll trigger the webhook timeout change as a canary in ap-southeast1 only. sam, jacob, priya standby for rollback.
sam: running canary patch now:

```
kubectl -n kube-system patch mutatingwebhookconfiguration oidc-introspection -p '{"webhooks":[{"name":"oidc.example.com","timeoutSeconds":2}]}'
```

sam: applied to ap-southeast1 control plane. metrics showing auth latency dropping within 90s :white_check_mark:
priya: controller-manager resyncs decreasing, node provisioning backlog clearing.
jacob: follow-up: need long-term fix — either improve OIDC introspection performance, add local caching of token validation, or make control plane async for node-status paths.
claire: created a ticket and tagged eng-runtime and eng-ml for root cause overlap (auth-proxy memory OOM earlier). ticket: https://redwood.example/tickets/INF-1187
infra-bot: incident note saved, severity set to SEV3, postmortem required if recurrence within 7 days.
claire: thanks team, keep an eye on ap-southeast1 for the next 2 hours and escalate if we see >50% increase in kubelet requeues.
sam: will do, monitoring dashboard pinned in #eng-sre :thumbsup:
